summary: Runways 09L/27R and 09R/27L closed at EGLL, with 09R/27L available for emergency traffic at 30 minutes' notice.
text:
RWY 09L/27R AND RWY 09R/27L CLSD. RWY 09R/27L CAN BE MADE AVBL
FOR EMERG TFC AT 30 MIN NOTICE. START OF RWY CLSD WILL BE DELAYED
UNTIL SKED MOV ARE COMPLETE. MOV DELAYED INTO NIGHT QUOTA PERIOD
ARE STILL SUBJ AD AUTHORITY APPROVAL. FOR INFO CTC AD DUTY MANAGER
